In the present petition, the petitioner challenges the impugned order dated 28.12.2023 passed in Bail Appln. 2827/2023 in case FIR No. 749/2023 registered at P.S.Alipur under Sections 498A/406/306/34 IPC.
2.
The challenge mainly pertains to the grant of anticipatory bail despite the fact that proclamation proceedings under Section 82 Cr.P.C had already been initiated against respondent no.2.

3. Mr. Mohit Mathur, learned senior counsel appearing for respondent no.2 states that since after the grant of the anticipatory bail, investigation has been completed and charge sheet has been filed in court and subsequent to the filing of the chargesheet, petitioner has already been granted regular bail by the trial court in the light of the judgment of This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 07/08/2025 at 22:45:06 Satender Kumar Antil Vs. CBI SLP (Crl) 5191/2021 dated 13.02.2024.

sentences.text: His submission is that once the court has already granted the regular bail, the challenge to the grant of anticipatory bail does not survive.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner however states that regular bail was in consequence to the grant of anticipatory bail by the Court.
He seeks time to place on record the case law.
